alt001.subject: New arrival: {origin} {varietal} · SCA {sca_cup_score}分
alt001.preheader: {process_method} lot from {origin} — {flavor_notes}. Just landed at Auctum Ledger.
alt001.body:
Hi {contact_first_name},

Our newest {origin} lot just landed: {varietal}, {process_method} process, scoring {sca_cup_score} on the SCA scale, with notes of {flavor_notes}. It is priced at {price_per_lb}/lb with {available_lbs} lbs available.

You can cup it before you commit — samples ship within 48 hours.

— {sender_name}, Auctum Ledger

alt002.subject: Cup {origin} before your next menu cycle
alt002.preheader: Your sample kit ships in 48 hours — {origin} {varietal} inside.
alt002.body:
Hi {contact_first_name},

Taste before you commit. The {origin} sample kit includes the {varietal} ({process_method}, SCA {sca_cup_score}分) our Q graders scored this week. Request your kit and we will ship within 48 hours — free for qualified roasters.

— {sender_name}, Auctum Ledger

alt003.subject: How {peer_roaster_name} built a menu around {origin}
alt003.preheader: A roaster case study: {process_method} lots scoring SCA {sca_cup_score}+分.
alt003.body:
Hi {contact_first_name},

{peer_roaster_name} added our {origin} {varietal} ({process_method}) to their single-origin menu last season — and sold through their first {order_volume_lbs} lbs in {sell_through_weeks} weeks. Here is what made it work, with the cupping data behind it.

— {sender_name}, Auctum Ledger

alt004.subject: {available_lbs} lbs left of {origin} {varietal}
alt004.preheader: {arrival_date} 到港——售完即止，请提前预订。
alt004.body:
Hi {contact_first_name},

A quick availability update: only {available_lbs} lbs remain of the {origin} {varietal} ({process_method}, SCA {sca_cup_score}分). The next container lands {arrival_date}, and reserved lots ship first. Reserve now to lock in {price_per_lb}/lb

— {sender_name}, Auctum Ledger

alt005.subject: {contact_first_name}，{harvest_window}的采购计划定了吗？
alt005.preheader: 告诉我们您的需求，我们为您匹配最合适的批次。
alt005.body:
Hi {contact_first_name},

We noticed the {origin} {varietal} did not make it onto your menu this time. If your plans for {harvest_window} are still open, reply with what you are looking for — process, score range, budget — and we will match lots to your list. Or book 15 minutes with our sourcing team.

— {sender_name}, Auctum Ledger
